//: This file makes the deploy work when Vercel's Root Directory is left at the
repo root (the default). Without it the build fails with:
sh: line 1: tsc: command not found
Error: Command "npm run build" exited with 127
Why: at the repo root Vercel installs the root package.json, which has no
dependencies. It then runs `npm run build`, which forwards into client/ —
but client/node_modules was never installed, so tsc does not exist.
So we install and build inside client/ explicitly, and point Vercel at
If you instead set Root Directory to `client` in project settings, Vercel
reads client/vercel.json and ignores this file. Both paths work.
buildCommand: npm --prefix client install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix client run build
installCommand: echo 'Dependencies are installed by buildCommand inside client/'
